meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: In poor-prognosis renal cancer, temsirolimus improved overall survival against interferon - the hardest endpoint there is.
data.mechanism_beginner: In hard-to-treat kidney cancer, temsirolimus helped patients live longer compared with an older drug.
data.boundary: Poor-prognosis patients specifically; the combination arm did not beat temsirolimus alone.
data.note: Overall survival, not a surrogate. Worth pointing at.
